units.source_text: 汗水顺着鼻梁滴下，流进了眼睛里。

en.t: Sweat trickled down the bridge of his nose and ran into his eyes.

units.source_text: 没有擦汗的功夫，他干脆闭着眼睛挥动铁锹。

en.t: With no time to wipe it away, he simply shut his eyes and swung the shovel.
His hands absolutely could not stop.

units.source_text: 瞧这等实在的速度，那些呆子，就是再不愿意也得承认自己的轻薄。

en.t: Seeing such solid speed, those fools would have to admit their own frivolity, however unwilling they were.
